16:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: SportsCenter Special
A look at what trade rumors were real and seeing how teams around the NFL are preparing for a championship run or building for the future. With Field Yates, Adam Schefter, Chris Mortensen, Dianna Russini, Mike Tannenbaum and Louis Riddick.

17:00 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: NFL Live
Host Laura Rutledge takes the helm of this weekday show featuring the likes of Marcus Spears, Dan Orlovsky, Mina Kimes, and Adam Schefter. The "NFL Live" crew entertains fans while offering all the latest news and analysis from across the NFL.
